description: Release gate: only rigorous, independently verified certificates may appear in published artifacts.
notes: Heuristic certificates carry no digest binding and must never appear in release artifacts.
Reproducible certificates are digest-bound but carry no rigorous interval bound; they are development-only.
replay_mode='from_scratch' ensures the certificate was produced by a fresh computation, not a self-consistency re-check.
Policy enforced by verify_rayleigh_certificate() + assurance/replay_mode field checks at release CI gate.
